name: uefitools
description: UEFI firmware analysis and manipulation tools for reverse engineering and security research

tools.description: Extract and analyze UEFI firmware images, modules, and components
tools.usage:
UEFIExtract firmware.fd # Extract all components from firmware
UEFIExtract -dump firmware.fd output/ # Extract to specific directory
UEFIExtract -info firmware.fd # Show firmware structure info
UEFIExtract -text firmware.fd # Extract as text for analysis

tools.description: Search for patterns, strings, and signatures within UEFI firmware images
tools.usage:
UEFIFind firmware.fd text 'string_to_find' # Search for text strings
UEFIFind firmware.fd hex '48656C6C6F' # Search for hex patterns
UEFIFind firmware.fd guid AAAAAAAA-BBBB-CCCC-DDDD-EEEEEEEEEEEE # Find GUID
UEFIFind firmware.fd all # Find all known patterns
